name: git-branch-explorer
description: Browse Git branches and history in the Codex side panel, with previews for commits, branch management and remote operations.

interface.shortDescription: Browse Git history and manage repositories in the side panel
interface.longDescription: Open a native Codex panel for local and remote branches, commit history and diffs. Preview and confirm staging, commits, branch creation, switching, merging, reverting, deletion of merged branches, fetch, pull and push. Follow the Codex theme, fonts and language, with English and Simplified Chinese UI.
defaultPrompt: Open the current project's Git branches and commit history in the right panel
在右侧面板查看当前项目的 Git 分支和提交记录
